decision.observation: At 6:30 p.m. Sunday, the farmer is at the left edge of the bus-stop road; the fenced dirt route east is clear.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing straight east will reach Pelican Town, where the southern junction's eastbound cobblestone road can be tested as the beach route.
decision.memory: Willy remains unmet and his promised item unreceived. From town's southern junction, stay on the eastbound cobblestone road; avoid dropping onto the grass or entering the wooded southern exit. Funds are 297g after repeated overnight failures.
